relations.myth: Reciprocal love, separation, messages, and swoons
relations.note: Majnun and Layla love one another but are separated by her family.

relations.myth: Death at Layli’s grave and paradisal reunion
relations.note: Majnun dies embracing Layli’s grave; they are buried together and reunited in Paradise.
Majnun asks God to increase or perpetuate his love instead of curing it.
